name: DSH Go
subtitle: DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋
localizedDescription: DSH Go 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的手机客户端：手机上本机运行，也能遥控电脑上正在跑的会话，可实时查看、操作与语音输入。源码遵循 AGPL-3.0。本源收录上游发布的未签名 iOS 构建（ipa），可通过 AltStore / SideStore 使用 Apple ID 自签安装。

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to DSH hosts you choose and, when enabled, this iPhone's local developer service for phone control.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Takes photos to send to DSH as attachments.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Picks images to send to DSH as attachments.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Saves generated images to your photo library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns voice input into text. Where the phone can't do it by itself, the audio goes to Apple's speech service.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Opens the calendar editor when you approve adding an event.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Looks up or adds contacts when you approve a request from the on-device engine.
privacy.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Reads or changes reminders when you approve a request from the on-device engine.
privacy.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Reads or changes reminders when you approve a request from the on-device engine.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reads your location for requests you approve. If you enable background location protection, location updates support active on-device tasks; the protection feature does not store or send coordinates.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only when you enable background location protection, uses location updates while an on-device task runs in the background. Coordinates are not stored or sent; this can increase battery use.
